title: Real Estate CRM Cost in India
seoTitle: Real Estate CRM Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What a real estate CRM costs in India: portal leads, site visits, bookings, payment schedules, channel partners, WhatsApp. Cost bands and timelines.
summary: A custom real estate CRM in India typically costs ₹6 lakh to ₹15 lakh for lead capture from portals, site visits, follow-ups and bookings, ₹15 lakh to ₹35 lakh with inventory, payment schedules, channel partner and customer portals, and more for developers with many projects and ERP integration.

costBands.includes: Leads from portals and ads, site visit scheduling, follow-ups, bookings, WhatsApp
Unit inventory, cost sheets, payment schedules and demands, channel partner and customer portals
Many projects, construction progress updates, ERP and accounting integration

dataPoints.label: Lead sources
dataPoints.value: Property portals, Meta and Google ads, website, walk-ins, channel partners

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost drivers
dataPoints.value: Inventory and pricing rules, payment schedules, portals for partners and buyers

body:
## What moves the price

- Unit inventory with dynamic pricing and holds.
- Demand letters and payment tracking by construction stage.
- Channel partner registration and brokerage.

See [software for real estate developers](/blog/software-for-real-estate-developers).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can leads from property portals flow in automatically?
faqs.a: Often yes, through portal integrations or email parsing, depending on each portal.

faqs.q: Can buyers see payment status online?
faqs.a: Yes, through a customer portal or app with demand letters and receipts.
